case_origin: Ethan Mollick — 'Fable 5.2 and Jagged AGI' ($20,000/yr Net Goal, <=20 Min/Month Human Cap)
overall_verdict: CONDITIONAL LAUNCH APPROVED — ALL 4 V1 JAGGED VETOES RESOLVED BY V2 ARCHITECTURE

personas.name: Mike Kowalski
personas.credentials: 15 Yrs Water/Wastewater & Park Equipment Manufacturers' Rep (Midwest/Southeast)
personas.v1_flaw_attacked: Scraping active RFP portals (overlap with BidNet/DemandStar) & unverified LLM multi-year budget numbers.
personas.hostile_critique: If you email me an RFP the week it hits BidNet, I'm already dead in the water—Xylem, TrojanUV, or Musco sat with the consulting engineer 6 months earlier and wrote the Basis-of-Design spec around their proprietary dimensions! Worse, if your bot reads a $7.1M 5-year CIP table in Raleigh and tells me it's a $7.1M order this quarter when FY26 only has $300K for design, I embarrass my agency in front of the Plant Manager.
non_negotiable_demands: Strict 90–240 day PRE-RFP window (CIP adoption books & council Basis-of-Design authorizations only).
Exact Spec-Influence Role (e.g., Utilities Maintenance Chief, WRRF Project Engineer)—not generic Purchasing Clerks.
Zero hallucinated dollar amounts: explicitly separate FY26 single-year tranche from 5-year CIP totals and flag GMP/CMAR lockouts.
personas.v2_engineered_fix: Enforced 90–240d Pre-RFP CIP filter + Deterministic Regex Span-Offset Verifier (`pipeline.py`) that isolates current-FY appropriations from 5-year horizons and flags GMP/CMAR post-spec items for Cockpit review.

personas.name: Debra Vance, MMC
personas.credentials: Master Municipal Clerk, 19 Yrs Local Government Public Records Officer
personas.v1_flaw_attacked: Fable 5.2's proposal to autonomously file state FOIA / Open Records requests when agenda attachments are missing.
personas.hostile_critique: This is the exact stunt that gets an AI startup on the national IIMC clerk warning listserv by Tuesday morning! Filing automated public-records requests to resell data commercially without a certified commercial-purpose statement violates Arizona A.R.S. § 39-121.03, triggers commercial fee recovery in Kentucky KRS § 61.874, and is flatly unlawful for out-of-state entities under Virginia FOIA § 2.2-3704. You will weaponize scarce public staff time and invite state AG scrutiny on your founder's personal name.
non_negotiable_demands: 100% prohibition on automated or manual FOIA / Open Records filings for commercial lead harvesting.
Zero inbound emails, webform submissions, or phone calls to Municipal Clerks.
Strict ingestion allowlist restricted to passive, already-published public APIs and adopted budget books.
personas.v2_engineered_fix: Kernel-level `PASSIVE_PLATFORM_ALLOWLIST` in `pipeline.py` (`Legistar_OData`, `OpenGov_CIP`, `ClearGov_Public`, `Municipal_CIP_PDF`). Any record with `requires_foia=true` (proven via `V1-FOIA-TRAP-999`) is hard-quarantined.

personas.name: Priya Nair, Esq.
personas.credentials: 12 Yrs GovTech SaaS, CAN-SPAM, Defamation & Data Provenance Counsel
personas.v1_flaw_attacked: Unmonitored autonomous cold email outreach + scraped personal PII + uncited LLM summaries of municipal contracts.
personas.hostile_critique: Fable 5.2 wanted full autonomy to scrape sales reps' emails and blast 2,500 LLM-personalized pitches a month. First, Google/Yahoo 2024+ bulk-sender thresholds (>0.3% spam complaint rate) will brick your domain in 11 days. Second, if an unmonitored LLM hallucinates that an incumbent vendor's pump 'failed catastrophically,' you face commercial disparagement liability. Third, an agent must NEVER have raw SMTP/POST credentials without an air-gap.
non_negotiable_demands: Mandatory Hardware-Style Air-Gap Switch: zero autonomous SMTP, webhook, or external HTTP POST execution.
Zero scraped personal email lists; acquire customers solely via opt-in trade association sponsorships + double opt-in.
Every lead must carry a verbatim `[char_start:char_end]` source excerpt + direct `.gov` URL + informational disclaimer.
personas.v2_engineered_fix: Air-Gap Batch Architecture (outputs static signed CSV/JSON digests only), zero PII scraping (role titles + public agency URLs only), verbatim character-span provenance on all 20 leads, and 100% opt-in SWEMA/WWEMA/NRPA channel GTM.

personas.name: Marcus Chen, CFA
personas.credentials: Bootstrapped B2B Data Micro-PE Partner & Former GovTech VP Finance
personas.v1_flaw_attacked: 201 bespoke municipal HTML DOM scrapers + underpriced $49/mo seats blowing both the 20-min cap and $20K net target.
personas.hostile_critique: Let's run the real math on 201 custom municipal HTML scrapers: municipal CMS updates break ~9% of bespoke DOM selectors every month. Fixing 18 broken scrapers at 38 minutes each equals 11.4 HOURS a month—34x over your 20-minute cap! Meanwhile, charging $49/mo means you need 45+ paying reps just to clear $20K after CAC and churn.
non_negotiable_demands: Consolidate ingestion onto <= 4 standardized municipal schemas so monthly maintenance stays <= 3 minutes.
Price on rep commission value ($199/mo Solo Territory | $449/mo Multi-Line Agency) where 1 spec win = 70x+ ROI.
Prove Month-1-to-Month-12 cohort cashflow clears >= $24,800 net profit in Year 1 on <= 18.0 minutes/month.
personas.v2_engineered_fix: 3 standardized connectors keep infra check to 2.5 min/mo + 15.0 min/mo Cockpit batch review = 17.5 min/mo total, delivering $33,254 actual Year-1 net profit ($54,624/yr M12 net run-rate).
